guidance: Store commercial potato consignments at 7°C to 10°C with 85% to 90% relative humidity to prevent shrinkage and sprouting while minimizing sugar accumulation.
Ensure ventilated jute or mesh bags are stacked no higher than 8 layers in 14-ft / 20-ft trucks to prevent bottom-bag compression blackspot bruising.
For chip and french fry processing, maintain tuber temperature above 8°C prior to washing to avoid cold-induced sweetening which causes dark frying.
